title: Using these guidelines
slide_intent: Teach readers to recognize the kind of instruction they are reading so they can distinguish a principle, a production detail and a caution at a glance.
strategic_value: A recurring icon vocabulary can help Special Olympics contributors navigate a long manual with different levels of design experience.
demonstration: A paragraph maps the four sections. Five labeled pictograms distinguish guidance types, and a separate red-outlined example identifies exercises.
practical_value: Use the pictogram and label to find the relevant advice before applying a rule or attempting an exercise.

content_islands.name: Section overview
content_islands.spec: Group the red heading and bold explanatory paragraph above the legend.

content_islands.name: Guidance legend
content_islands.spec: Set five icons in a row with red labels and brief definitions beneath them. Align the introductory note to the left of the row.

content_islands.name: Exercise key
content_islands.spec: Put the exercise symbol and its explanation together in a red-outlined box below the legend.
